SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'server_major',current_setting('server_version_num')::integer/10000,
 'functions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(p.proname,jsonb_build_object('sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid),'UTF8')),'hex'),'owner',pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner),'securityDefiner',p.prosecdef,'config',p.proconfig,'volatility',p.provolatile,'parallel',p.proparallel)),'{}'::jsonb) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname IN ('storyboard_production_admin','storyboard_production_worker','storyboard_production_model_available','storyboard_production_reject_archived_write')),
 'constraints',(SELECT jsonb_object_agg(c.conname,pg_get_constraintdef(c.oid)) FROM pg_constraint c WHERE c.conrelid IN ('public.admin_storyboard_production_projects'::regclass,'public.admin_storyboard_production_revisions'::regclass)),
 'archiveTriggers',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(t.tgname ORDER BY t.tgname),'[]'::jsonb) FROM pg_trigger t WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgname LIKE 'storyboard_archive_%'),
 'activeJobs',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.admin_storyboard_production_jobs WHERE status IN ('queued','claimed'))
)::text;

constraints.admin_storyboard_production_projects_che: CHECK (((document IS NULL) OR ((jsonb_typeof(document) = 'object'::text) AND (octet_length((document)::text) <= 196608) AND ((document ->> 'schema'::text) = 'storyboard-mlx-v1'::text) AND ((document ->> 'projectId'::text) = (id)::text) AND (((document ->> 'revision'::text))::integer = revision))))
constraints.admin_storyboard_production_revisions_ch: CHECK (((jsonb_typeof(document) = 'object'::text) AND (octet_length((document)::text) <= 196608) AND ((document ->> 'schema'::text) = 'storyboard-mlx-v1'::text) AND ((document ->> 'projectId'::text) = (project_id)::text) AND (((document ->> 'revision'::text))::integer = revision)))
constraints.admin_storyboard_production_projects_own: FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.admin_storyboard_production_revisions_pr: FOREIGN KEY (project_id, owner_id) REFERENCES admin_storyboard_production_projects(id, owner_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
